title.zh: COVID-19（临时措施）（某些程序停止适用第 28 条）命令 2022
title.en: COVID-19 (Temporary Measures) (Cessation of Section 28 for Certain Proceedings) Order 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the COVID-19 (Temporary Measures) (Cessation of Section 28 for Certain Proceedings) Order 2022 and comes into operation on 1 April 2022.

3. Despite paragraph 2, section 28 of the Act continues to apply to or in relation to —
(a)any court proceedings in respect of which an order under section 28(1) of the Act was made before 1 April 2022;
(b)any evidence given by an accused person or a witness in any court proceedings, by means of a live video or live television link that is created using a remote communication technology approved by the Chief Justice, pursuant to an order under section 28(1) of the Act made before 1 April 2022; and
(c)any appearance made (other than to give evidence) by an accused person or a witness in any court proceedings, by means of a live video, live television link or live audio link that is created using a remote communication technology approved by the Chief Justice, pursuant to an order under section 28(1) of the Act made before 1 April 2022.
